entries.ai_recommendation_summary: AI recommended an always-on sandbox for instant shared read-only API exploration.
entries.rationale: Cisco says Always-On sandboxes require no reservation, are shared, restrict administrative access, and support non-admin APIs. That directly matches the need for immediate shared read-only requests without provisioning delay.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: AI recommended a reservation sandbox for private administrative configuration testing.
entries.rationale: Cisco describes Reservation sandboxes as private, reservation-based environments accessed through VPN with full administrative access. The scheduled access, VPN, and setup-time requirements in this scenario all align with that model.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: AI recommended a learning lab for structured beginner API concept practice.
entries.rationale: Cisco’s Learning Labs provide structured learning content, interactive tutorials, and built-in development environments. This is more suitable for a beginner needing step-by-step guidance than an independent administrative sandbox.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: AI recommended Code Exchange for finding reusable Cisco and community automation examples.
entries.rationale: Cisco presents Code Exchange as a community for sharing code and sample solutions, including implementations for Cisco technologies. That directly supports examining existing network-automation repositories before designing new code.
